items.title: War in Ukraine passes 1,569 days, now longer than WWI
items.description: British, French and German ambassadors to Russia held talks Thursday in Russia's foreign ministry, as the war in Ukraine reaches a grim milestone. 1,569 days and counting… The Russian full scale invasion of Ukraine started a century after World War One began and it's now gone on longer than that confit itself.
